name: Kumeny-Bolshoy Perelaz Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Kirov Oblast)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Kumeny-Bolshoy Perelaz Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline; Kumeny-Vichevshchina Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS found. Trunk runs from Kumeny (pgt Kumyony) south/east through Kumensky District to Vichevshchina, serving Bolshoy Perelaz, Gorodchiki, Zhelny, Beltyugi, Verkhobystritsa and Bereznik; candidate for route-creation from settlement coordinates.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. No roster match: no Kirov Oblast row on the roster (checked args roster and GGIT snapshot 20260930 Start/End province; P3973/P3974/P3978 are Ivanovo/other-region proposed lines, different). Thresholds: sponsor Gazprom (built under Kirov Oblast Gas Supply and Gasification Programme 2021-2025; Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Kirov / Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Kirov); endpoints Kumeny to Vichevshchina/Bolshoy Perelaz; concrete step = commissioned (built operating line GEM never captured); length 59.5 km >= 25 km sourced. Sources: GTRK Vyatka 2022-12-24 (Gazprom specialists commissioned the inter-settlement pipeline from Kumeny to Vichevshchina, 59.5 km, to serve Bolshoy Perelaz, Gorodchiki, Zhelny, Beltyugi, Verkhobystritsa, Bereznik; about 400 households, 7 boiler houses); Newsler.ru 2023-01-12 (Kirov Oblast Government release: 59.5 km, longest inter-settlement line in Kirov Oblast; first households connected at Bolshoy Perelaz 2023-01-12). Both fetched and verified; not independent in origin (Gazprom/regional government release) so independent=false, tier high on single-validated-ref rule. Endpoint ambiguity: GTRK says Kumeny to Vichevshchina, Newsler says from Kumeny to Bolshoy Perelaz (first connection point); End set to Vichevshchina per the commissioning statement, queue name kept; resolve on route creation. StartYear1 2022-12 = commissioning per GTRK 2022-12-24 (first gas connection 2023-01-12). Owner set to Gazprom PJSC (existing entity per entity_lookup) because sources say Gazprom built it; the operating subsidiary Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Kirov was not found as an existing entity and no source states title ownership, so not used. Type 59.5 km described as the pipeline length ('протяженность 59,5 км'), though the Newsler lede says '59,5 км сетей'; treated as the single trunk. Diameter, capacity, cost not found.
